title: 第5章 丧尸猫！开启一阶基因锁！
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

片刻后，罗兰强忍着的恶心将长刀擦干净，跑到没有丧尸的卧室狠狠吸了一口新鲜空气，这才缓了过来。

“没有，看来，这些丧尸之中，并不是每一头丧尸脑袋里都有丧尸晶核存在的！”

“不过，如果是高等丧尸，或许脑袋中存在晶核的可能就会变大很多！”

罗兰来到卧室窗户边上，狠狠呼吸，压制自己想要呕吐的欲望。

他刚才检查的很仔细，但是却依旧没有在这两头丧尸身上找到晶核的存在。

“低等丧尸晶核。”

罗兰举起长刀，一个乳白色的低等丧尸晶核静静躺在刀身上。

既然这个东西被蓝星意志认定为是低等丧尸晶核，那么这个世界上，必然存在高等级的丧尸晶核！

罗兰目光一闪，旋即念头一动，心中低呼一声：“转化为源能！”

低等丧尸晶核，虽然吸收后，有较小概率能增强体质，但是却有很大概率感染丧尸病毒，罗兰自然不会去干这种自掘坟墓的事情。

蓝星意志将低等丧尸晶核转化为源能的速度很快，一瞬间不到，罗兰就看到这个低等丧尸晶核消失在了眼前，而他的数据面板上，也增加了一个新的数据！

源能：100

“一百的源能，说多不多，但是也不少了。”

“这个世界，有这么多丧尸存在，虽然不是每一个丧尸体内都有晶核存在，但是只要运气不太差，我的收获就不会小！”

罗兰将长刀收回刀鞘，正准备再次吸引一些丧尸过来击杀的时候，突然神色一动，看向了窗外的街道上。

窗外街道上，有一些零零散散的丧尸在游荡，而此刻这些漫无目的游荡的丧尸似乎被什么东西吸引到了一样，顿时宛如打了鸡血，朝着一个方向快速移动。

很快，一个背着背包，显得很狼狈的人影，就出现在了罗兰眼中。

“是和我一起在觉醒室进入试炼世界的徐海。”

罗兰看到正在被丧尸追击的徐海，目光微动。

徐海他认识，同在一个觉醒室，不过接触不多，对他罗兰也不太了解。

而就在罗兰看到徐海的时候，狼狈躲避丧尸追赶的徐海，此刻也发现了站在三楼窗户后的罗兰。

“是罗兰？”

徐海目光一亮，脚步加快，以他抵达人体极限的敏捷属性，猛地一个冲刺，借着墙壁、窗沿，几个动作下来，便双手一撑，来到了罗兰身前。

而这个时候，罗兰也已经

“呼！”

感觉自己安全了之后，徐海便喘了几大块粗气，放下背包，感觉好多了之后，便一脸后怕：“罗兰，你遇到这些怪物了没有？”

“你不知道，这些怪物有多恐怖！不但不怕死，不怕疼，一旦发现你之后，就一拥而上，我差点就被它们给留下来了！”

“我遇到了，不过数量少，对我没有什么危险。”罗兰说道。

After a while, Roland suppressed the nausea and wiped the long knife clean. He ran to the bedroom where there were no zombies and took a deep breath of fresh air before he recovered.

"No, it seems that not every zombie among these zombies has a zombie crystal core in its head!"

"However, if it is a high-level zombie, the possibility of having a crystal core in its head will be much greater!"

Roland came to the bedroom window, breathed hard, and suppressed his desire to vomit.

He had checked very carefully just now, but he still could not find the presence of crystal nuclei on the two zombies.

"Low-level zombie crystal core."

Roland raised the long knife, and a milky-white low-level zombie crystal core lay quietly on the knife.

Since this thing is regarded as a low-level zombie crystal core by the will of Blue Star, then there must be high-level zombie crystal nuclei in this world!

Roland's eyes flashed, and then he had a thought and whispered in his heart: "Convert into source energy!"

Although low-level zombie crystal nuclei have a small chance of strengthening their physique after being absorbed, there is a high chance of being infected with the zombie virus. Naturally, Roland would not dig his own grave.

Blue Star's will converted the low-level zombie crystal core into source energy very quickly. In less than a split second, Roland saw the low-level zombie crystal core disappear before his eyes, and a new data was added to his data panel!

Source Energy: 100

"One hundred source energy is not too much, but it is not too much."

"There are so many zombies in this world. Although not every zombie has a crystal core in it, as long as my luck is not too bad, my gains will not be small!"

Roland put the long knife back into the scabbard and was about to attract some zombies to kill him again when his expression suddenly changed and he looked out the window at the street.

There were some scattered zombies wandering on the street outside the window. At this moment, these zombies wandering aimlessly seemed to be attracted by something. They suddenly moved quickly in one direction as if they had been given a shot of blood.

Soon, a very embarrassed figure carrying a backpack appeared in Roland's eyes.

"It's Xu Hai who entered the trial world in the awakening room with me."

Roland's eyes moved slightly when he saw Xu Hai being chased by zombies.

He knew Xu Hai, he was in the same awakening room, but he didn't have much contact with him, and he didn't know much about Roland.

And just when Roland saw Xu Hai, who was hiding from the zombies in a panic, he also spotted Roland standing behind the window on the third floor.

"Is it Roland?"

Xu Hai's eyes lit up, his steps quickened, and with his agility that reached the limit of the human body, he sprinted suddenly, using the walls and window edges, and after a few movements, he reached in front of Roland with both hands.

At this time, Roland had also

"Phew!"

After feeling that he was safe, Xu Hai took a few heavy breaths and put down his backpack. After feeling much better, he looked scared and asked: "Roland, have you encountered these monsters?"

"You don't know how terrifying these monsters are! Not only are they not afraid of death, they are not afraid of pain. Once they find you, they swarm you. I was almost left behind by them!"

"I encountered them, but the number was small and there was no danger to me." Roland said.
